result.rationale: Direct regulatory, investor and seller records support Astoria Power Partners Holding, LLC as the probable one-platform survivor, verify the 2020 transaction boundary and Munich Re facts, and report MR Gotham LP at 20.0000% of APPH at 2025 year-end. They do not prove final post-closing allocations, cutoff-current continuity and exact interests for every consortium member, or reciprocal legal identity between the requested Astoria Energy Partners label and APPH. A company merge or ownership correction would require inference.

evidence.purpose: Direct filed evidence for the APPH hierarchy, 2020 transaction parties, historical allocations, project boundaries, and the express closing-adjustment limitation.
